authorization: User requested the 27.09 quality cycle (edge objects, ride false events, GO overclaims, history-dependent false STOP; ML allowed) and a re-judgement; this seal replaces detector_freeze_2026-09-26.json as the reference detector. Re-sealed after the independent two-judge review of the first 27.09 version (8b74cd0): the review's safety fixes of 65c5a5b were requested as part of the same cycle. Re-sealed again after the second review round (the miss-branch near check, the opinion retrained on the shipped detector with a 2x threshold margin).

decisions.gauge.reference: 3 (the union) within 60 m on straight track, offset clamp 0.2 m: a return takes the sensor-axis lateral only where it is nearer the centre, so the rails' envelope is never narrowed; mode 2 (the one-sided shift of 8b74cd0) not shipped (safety review); the gains rest on the organizers' sensor-axis placement frame, organizer Q1 unanswered
decisions.tracking.doubt_*: learned track opinion retrained on the shipped detector (resense/models/track_opinion.json), threshold 0.015 = a 2x margin below the highest that delays no held-out synthetic sequence (0.03); cross-fitted ride measurement 43 -> 37 events held out (33 at zero margin, not chosen); at most 10 withheld frames over a track's life, never within 25 m (also over a missed frame, at the predicted distance), never for a cluster >= 1.0 m tall within 40 m
decisions.tracking.thin_far_min_distance / cluster: far evidence: a track whose gauge vote needs far scan-line / weak hits is a STOP only while approaching, advisory otherwise (never hidden); set F 1 m box -2 / +5 frames at 50-100 / 100-150 m (information rows of the gate)
decisions.track.axis_disagree_hold: off: no detection gain in combination, up to 4.5% monitored-range cost
decisions.tracking.zone_min_votes / start_clean: off: each delays a set F or set O positive by a frame

change_policy: Blocker fixes only; review the fix, repeat affected checks and the full gate, then replace this seal.
limits: Verification checks source and evidence integrity; it does not replay recordings.
Node, launch, Docker and documentation have separate acceptance checks.
A detector freeze is not a release, deployment approval or proof of safety.
